title: Malaysian Bao
description: Soft yeast-based bao filled with a sweet and spicy Malaysian-inspired filling.

ingredients.name: Zesty filling
ingredients.notes: Made with a mix of chili sauce, soy sauce, and sugar

ingredients.name: Malaysian seasoning
ingredients.notes: A blend of coriander, cumin, and turmeric

instructions: Roll out bao dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of zesty filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a bun.
Brush tops with vegetable oil and bake for 15-20 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped scallions.
